title: Phase 4-5 evaluation and model details (fixed before any model sees the samples)
basis: Design choices only. Samples exist (Phase 3); no model, score or metric has been computed on them.

value.primary_design: leave-one-inventory-out over the development inventories (train on one, test on the other); both directions reported
value.primary_statistic: unweighted mean over held-out inventories of the per-inventory ROC AUC; paired differences use the same resamples
value.bootstrap: resample 5 km blocks with replacement independently within each held-out inventory, 2000 resamples, seed seeds.bootstrap; percentile 95 % interval
value.null: 500 permutations of labels within 5 km blocks of the held-out inventory (seed seeds.permutation); one-sided p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + n)
value.phase4_gate: lower bound of the 95 % interval of [mean AUC(primary model) - mean AUC(slope_only)] > 0
value.secondary_design: spatial block CV inside each inventory: 5 folds of 5 km blocks (seed seeds.folds); training samples closer than 1000 m to any test sample removed
value.threshold_metrics: threshold = 80th percentile of held-out background scores; recall in the top 20 % area, precision, F1, balanced accuracy and confusion matrix at that threshold
value.boyce: continuous Boyce index (Hirzel et al. 2006): 101 moving windows of width 0.1 on min-max scaled held-out scores, Spearman correlation of predicted-to-expected ratio
value.dominance: report without the largest block if it holds more than 20 percent of held-out positives
value.counted_comparisons: every model and baseline evaluated is listed in the report; none is dropped

evaluation.reason: The registration fixed metrics and the gate in words; the exact statistic, resampling and thresholds are fixed here before any model output exists.

value.preprocessing: logistic regression and MLP: median imputation plus standard scaling fitted on the training fold only; tree models take NaN natively
value.baselines: slope_only, elevation_only: logistic regression on the single feature fitted on the training fold (orientation learned from training data); simple_logistic: slope, elevation, profile and plan curvature; random: 0.5 and the permutation null
value.tuning: none; the parameters above are fixed (no grid search, so no selection on any held-out data)
value.lightgbm_xgboost: not added; scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting is the gradient-boosting benchmark (no new dependency)

model_spec.reason: Fixed hyperparameters remove any possibility of selecting on held-out inventories.

preconditions: registration present; nothing from stage 'models' on existed
